text: 创业板指跌超2%，沪指跌超1%，深成指跌1.87%，贵金属、白酒、房地产、PCB等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股超4400只
text_en: ChiNext Index drops over 2%, Shanghai Composite falls over 1%, Shenzhen Component down 1.87%; precious metals, baijiu, real estate, PCB among the biggest decliners; more than 4,400 stocks fall across the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets
